'''Melida/Daan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas Online Companion" /> For centuries, it was engulfed in a [[Melida/Daan Civil War|civil war]] between the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] and the [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] factions which could not even agree on a name for the planet. The Melida called it '''Melida''' and the Daan called it '''Daan''', so the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] used Melida and Daan separated by a slash. [[Mission to Melida/Daan|Eventually]], a group called [[the Young]], led by various children of the Melida and Daan,<ref name="The Defenders of the Dead" /> rose up and ended the civil war in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].<ref name="The Uncertain Path" /> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] temporarily left the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to aid the Young in their quest,<ref name="The Defenders of the Dead" /> helping to end the war.<ref name="The Uncertain Path" /> Parts of the planet were scarred from the war.<ref name="The Defenders of the Dead" />

With a fast [[Starship/Legends|starship]], it took three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] to travel from Melida/Daan to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="The Uncertain Path" />
